heroHeadline: Designs that make your brand impossible to ignore.
heroSub: I help businesses stand out, build trust and win customers with brand identities, flyers, social media and album art that look sharp and sell.
quoteMessage: Hi Joseph, I saw your portfolio and I would like to discuss a project.
aboutText:
A creative brand designer specializing in strategic visual solutions that help businesses stand out, build trust, and connect with their target audience.

I create high-quality brand identities, social media content, marketing materials, flyers, and landing pages that blend creativity with strategy. Every design is crafted with precision and purpose to elevate your brand and support your business goals.
toolsNote: I also explore AI tools and integrate them across design direction, concept development, and creative exploration.

services.title: Brand Identity & Logo
services.text: A logo and visual system that makes your business look established and trustworthy from day one.

services.title: Flyers & Social Media
services.text: Scroll-stopping campaign designs that turn views into enquiries and sales.

services.title: Album & Music Art
services.text: Bold illustrated cover art that helps your release stand out on every platform.

services.title: Print & Marketing Materials
services.text: Flyers, banners, signage and brand collateral that stay consistent everywhere your customers see you.

process.title: Tell me your idea
process.text: Share your goals, audience and any references. A quick chat on WhatsApp is enough.

process.title: Concept
process.text: I develop a direction that fits your brand and business goals before polishing details.

process.title: Design & revisions
process.text: You review, I refine until it feels right.

process.title: Delivery
process.text: You receive clean, ready-to-use files for print and digital.
